0.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_000
0.description: Thinking of trying your hand at a little dragonslaying, are you? Well, be my guest─so long as you know what you're up against. Those scaly bastards are smarter than you think, and crafty with it.

1.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_001
1.description: Hail, <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203>! If you're thinking of heading out hunting in the Churning Mists, I've got some information that you might find to your advantage.

3.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_A1_000_001
3.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (Scitalis)

4.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_A1_000_002
4.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (The Scarecrow)

5.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_A1_000_003
5.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Bune)

6.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_A1_000_004
6.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Agathos)

7.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_A1_000_005
7.description: Tell me about the rank S elite mark. (Gandarewa)

9.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_010
9.description: As wyverns grow, they progress through a number of developmental stages, their bodies becoming more and more streamlined with each change. In their final forms, even their horns drop off, leaving them with a sleek shape perfectly suited for flight.

10.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_011
10.description: It is one such elder wyvern that has been marked for death by a certain nobleman. It seems the beast has taken something of a fancy to the fellow's son─a pretty young thing I wouldn't mind gobbling up myself. Mayhap not in the same manner as the wyvern, though...

11.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_012
11.description: You should be able to spot this monster easily enough─its sleek, shining scales have earned it the name “Scitalis,” after a legendary dragon with similarly lustrous skin.

12.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_020
12.description: Not long ago, a party of Temple Knights headed into the foothills of Sohm Al to spy on the dragons' activities. However, a few days into their mission, they disappeared without a trace. A rescue party was dispatched to find the missing knights, and find them it did.

13.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_021
13.description: They discovered their missing comrades standing over the body of a vinegaroon─a fearsome scalekin in thrall to the dragons. But as they approached, the monster suddenly rose to its feet and sprang at the would-be rescuers, slaying several before they could ready themselves.

14.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_022
14.description: The Temple Knights were all dead─the Scarecrow had propped up their corpses to lure their rescuers into a trap. After taking its toll on the rescue party, the monster fled up the slopes of Sohm Al, and naught has been seen of it since. We believe it may yet be hiding in the Churning Mists.

15.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_030
15.description: Most heretics are drawn from common stock, but there are more than a few nobles among them too. One such fellow was the husband of a lady Temple Knight─unbeknownst to her, he abused his position to steal the order's secrets and feed them to the dragons.

16.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_031
16.description: For years the nobleman passed sensitive information to the Horde, until the day he grew weary of his double life and supped from the scaly cup, transforming himself into a monstrous scalekin. His plan was simple─to slaughter his family, feign his own death, and join with the dragons.

17.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_032
17.description: Thanks to the timely intervention of the order, the former parts of his plan were foiled, but the beast broke their cordon and succeeded in fleeing to Dravania. It was one of the Temple Knights who put the bounty on his head─the very lady who was once his wife.

18.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_040
18.description: Do you know the story of Saint Valeroyant? Eight centuries ago, he served as an Azure Dragoon, and won glory by driving away the great wyrm Nidhogg. This very square still bears his name, though his image has seen better days.

19.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_041
19.description: He was an unrivaled warrior who dealt death to dragon after dragon, but there was one that always managed to slip his clutches─Agathos, feared across the land as the <hex:021A020203>Black Death<hex:021A020103>.

20.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_042
20.description: Naught has been seen of the creature since Valeroyant's passing, but in recent years, rumors have been spreading of a shadow of Agathos's size and shape appearing in the clouds above Dravania. Could this be our chance to bring Saint Valeroyant's legend to a close?

21.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_050
21.description: It isn't only the dragons who have brought heretics into our midst, you know. Five hundred years ago, another heretical sect gained traction among the smallfolk of Ishgard.

22.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_051
22.description: The heathens adopted the customs of the Near East, bathing themselves in perfumes brewed from strange flowers and forging idols from rare metals that they used in their bizarre and unholy rites.

23.name: TEXT_REGROC2NOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTT1B_00269_EUSTACIA_000_052
23.description: Naturally, the Temple Knights were quick to clamp down on the sect's activities. Its leader, a peasant who styled himself the great guru Gandarewa, fled to the next holiest place he knew─the sacred mountain of Dravania. There he supped on the blood of a dragon, and was forever changed...
